newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit wins cellular pact in China.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit wins cellular pact in China.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its Greater China Cellular Infrastructure Division won a contract to install a digital cellular telephone network in the Jiangsu province of China.

Motorola said the $16 million contract will include deployment of its base stations and switches. It will have the capacity to provide telephone service to 60,000 subscribers in six cities in China, the company said.
Motorola develops telecommunications products, semiconducors and advanced electronic systems.
Its shares were trading up 5/8 Monday at 67-1/2.
